reason: The door rules from the 2026-10-30 doctrine amendment, and the shell prop that keeps the invite on the organiser door, are repo-specific and easy to break: a plain "Log in" link to the wrong door reads as a bug to a signed-out visitor. No existing project skill covers sign-in link labelling.

Ivan's 2026-11-01 ruling on organiser wrong-door copy is a durable product rule that governs this same login-door surface, and no existing skill states it. Adding it here puts the rule where the next /login copy change will be made.
The wrong-door copy rule was not reachable from its current trigger, which names only the link labels. Adding the copy trigger makes the rule load when someone edits the /login failure text.
